Area.evidence_source: One important theme (n ¼ 9) was loss of economic control. Attaining economic control seemed a precondition for fulfilling masculine aspirations of these men. One aspect of loss of economic control was constrained livelihood. Challenges with employment led to frustrations and distress for some of the men. For example, one friend reflected, "I was thinking it was because of frustration and stress which he went through due to the collapse of his once vibrant business." This friend connected negative affect with the collapsed business, which shattered a previous life anchored on business success. His spouse said, "Life became very difficult to bear at that time, he was owing the suppliers." The job loss had consequences in the family domain.
